culture._comment: Near / far from the ancestors (docs/plan_civilization_steps.md 'What belief does, through seams that exist'; .claude/rules/core_sim/belief.md 'The culture morale term'). Each band remembers one belief tile, its anchor. With b = the anchor's belief and s = b / (b + belief_half_saturation), the morale term is +near_bonus x s while the band stands within walking reach of the anchor (migration.base_reach, lengthened by roads exactly as migration's reach is) and -away_drag x s beyond it; 0 with no anchor. In or out of reach is binary - the drag does not grow with distance. PLAYTEST DIALs.
culture._comment_near_bonus: Morale per turn gained standing within reach of a saturated anchor. PLAYTEST DIAL.
culture._comment_away_drag: Morale per turn lost standing beyond reach of a saturated anchor. PLAYTEST DIAL.
culture._comment_belief_half_saturation: Belief at which the anchor weighs one half. Belief is in dead-equivalents, so 10 = ten people's worth of ancestors: a single death barely registers and a great cemetery caps the term. Must be > 0. PLAYTEST DIAL.
